**Who is it for**
This is built primarily for NSO and RBI users — an analyst who will be asked to defend
the number — and secondarily for airlines, researchers and the public.

**How does it improve the statistic**
The project's test is whether a feature improves the accuracy, reproducibility,
timeliness or auditability of an official price statistic. If it cannot be defended
that way, say so and argue for it anyway — but say so.
